name: smwgraphics-smw-princess-bowser-bowsette-graphics-pack
title: SMW Princess Bowser/Bowsette Graphics Pack
description:
Custom graphics that replace some existing Bowser related sprites with a peculiar looking Princess Peach/Bowser monster girl fusion. It comes with:

-Graphics for SMW Bowser (comes with a patch that overwrites vanilla Bowser's palette).

-Mikeyk's SMB1 Custom Bowser. (Don't forget to convert it with Trashkas before)

-Graphics for SMW Peach.

Credit's optional, but it would be highly appreciated.

(If there's enough demand, I might try tackling other artstyles as well like SMB3 and Redrawn).
